user.title: Labeled Features
user.description: Leaders, features and followers are always configured with labels. These settings are the instance-level values that used to live as labels on the template sensors; labels on the created sensor entities still win over them.

data_description.prefix: Sensors are created as sensor.<prefix>s_state and sensor.<prefix>_areas_state. The default 'labeled_feature' reproduces the legacy entity IDs. This cannot be changed later.
data_description.leader_label: Label that identifies leader entities and the areas scanned for 'Provides:' declarations.
data_description.default_mode: Used when no '<Scoped Feature> Mode:' label or override matches.
data_description.default_script_call_mode: Forward-looking default. The YAML Leaders automation still reads Script Call Mode from labels on the sensor.
data_description.alert_action: Action called by the alert error tier with alert_severity / alert_title / alert_message fields.
data_description.alert_severity: Severity passed to the alert action.
data_description.mode_overrides: One per line, using label syntax: 'Area Night Mode: All'.
data_description.script_call_mode_overrides: One per line, using label syntax: 'Area Sleep Timer Script Call Mode: NonBlocking'.

error.invalid_prefix: The prefix must be a valid slug (lowercase letters, digits and underscores).
error.prefix_in_use: Another Labeled Features instance already uses this prefix.
error.alert_action_invalid: The alert action must look like 'domain.service', e.g. script.send_alert.
error.invalid_mode_override: Every line must look like '<Scoped Feature> Mode: Leader|Any|All'.
error.invalid_script_call_mode_override: Every line must look like '<Scoped Feature> Script Call Mode: Blocking|NonBlocking'.

user.title: Add leader definition
user.description: Define a feature leader without labels. Equivalent to `Feature Leader` + `(Area |Floor |)Leader: <Feature>` plus modifier labels. Used only when the entity has no label definition for the same feature/scope — labels win on conflict.

data_description.scope: area / floor / global — equivalent to the Area / Floor / bare label prefix.
data_description.enable_value: Enabled while state equals this value.
data_description.disable_value: Disabled while state equals this value.
data_description.direction: Numeric direction evaluation. Takes precedence over enable/disable values.

user.title: Add Provides declaration
user.description: Declare an area-level Provides feature without labels. Equivalent to an `(Area |Floor |)Provides: <Feature>` label on the area (plus optional Component modifier). Used only when the area has no label declaration for the same feature/scope — labels win on conflict.

data_description.scope: area / floor / none — equivalent to the Area / Floor / bare label prefix.
data_description.component: Component hint recorded in label_map (default select).

user.title: Add feature mode
user.description: Set the fold mode for a (feature, scope) pair without labels. Equivalent to a `<Scoped Feature> Mode: Leader|Any|All` label on the sensor entity. A matching Mode label on the sensor wins over this subentry.

data_description.mode: leader = only the triggering leader counts; any = OR over all mapped leaders; all = AND over all mapped leaders.

options.leader: Leader — only the leader that drove the tick
options.any: Any — OR across every leader of the triple
options.all: All — AND across every leader of the triple

set_feature.description: Write a manual override into the Labeled Features State sensor's features attribute.

set_snapshot.name: Set snapshot
set_snapshot.description: Merge or delete an entry in the snapshots attribute.
